description:
Genericana, also known as Neo-Retro or Contemporary-Conformist , is a visual design aesthetic that was popularized in the late 2000s and remained prominent through the mid 2010s. It is characterized by old-timey Americana imagery, badges and seals, hand-lettered and ornamental typography, decorative borders, and vintage commercial ephemera.

The name "Genericana" is a portmanteau of the words "generic" and "Americana," and was coined by Consumer Aesthetics Research Institute researcher tranquility2099. Its primary alternate title, "Contemporary-Conformist," comes from a series of satirical blog posts by "Carles," the anonymous creator of Hipster Runoff and its successor, Carles.Buzz, both of which are no longer in operation. Carles' work, though parodic, is the source for most of the foundational research of the Genericana aesthetic. [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Authenticity, craftsmanship, originality, artisanship
